11 October 2026 · Pocket Flight private lab · codex/private-wind-tunnel

Premium chamber rebuild

The chamber has been rebuilt as a complete aerospace test enclosure with rounded portals, a formed inlet, broad observation glazing, fitted roof cassettes, a recessed deck and a layered extraction turbine. The inspection view opens the near wall and roof so the aircraft remains easy to examine. Full chamber restores the complete enclosure.

Rendering measurements

Finch U–260.217.4 ms70100

Aurelia S3260.217.5 ms111132
Stormbird HX–4060.517.6 ms6485

1440 × 1000 desktop viewport, DPR 1, Chromium with Metal. Active inspection samples last about 1.8 seconds per aircraft. Complete-enclosure draw calls were captured after switching views. These are local short samples, not cross-device or sustained thermal benchmarks.

The opaque static structure is batched by compatible material and attributes. Roof and near-wall sections are batched independently so visibility can switch without rebuilding geometry. Aircraft detail and solver panel counts are retained. The animated fan avoids frozen dynamic shadows; paused, settled views stop rendering.

Verification

  • Private TypeScript/production build passes.
  • 107 repository tests pass, with 8,821 assertions, in the saved full-suite run.
  • 23 general browser acceptance checks, 12 optimization checks, and 13 new chamber checks pass with zero browser errors.
  • All four aircraft retain 122 airflow paths with zero rejected paths at the reference condition.
  • All four aircraft fit the unchanged 16 × 12 × 28 m test section at −8°, 0° and +8°.
  • The Blender file reopens with all 326 native mesh objects, finite vertices, both complete enclosure sections saved visible, and the aircraft/fan datums preserved.
  • The GLB audit matches the modeled mesh count and verifies finite exported vertices, complete cutaway sections and mounting points. The export contains 135,472 triangles.
  • Saved browser images were reviewed for complete desktop and 390-pixel mobile framing.

The chamber is a concept environment. The numerical solver remains steady, inviscid main-wing analysis in freestream. It does not model enclosure-wall or support interference. Architectural detail and airflow visuals do not establish CFD accuracy.
